steps.quote: Review the declined transaction history (transactions with type 'atm_withdrawal_declined' or 'pos_declined') and card data to calculate the following flags:

steps.do: For each locked card, check the automatic triggers first. A security_hold card cannot be unlocked here; it goes to the security-hold transfer offer. If several cards are locked, investigate every card before unlocking any of them. If a card was replaced as stolen in the last 90 days, enhanced verification is required.
steps.quote: If another card on the same account also has pin_locked = TRUE → Finish investigating all cards before any unlock. Each card must be scored individually and may have different outcomes.

steps.do: Score each card that has no security hold. Use flags A1-A3 (location), B1-B3 (time), C1-C4 (amount), D1-D3 (card history) and E1-E3 (account). Never reveal the calculation to the customer.
steps.quote: When a debit card shows pin_locked = TRUE, agents must perform a comprehensive fraud risk assessment before unlocking. DO NOT REVEAL THE SPECIFIC CALCULATIONS TO USERS.

steps.do: If the score is 5 or higher and a location flag scored, ask whether the customer was at the location of the declined attempt. If yes, remove the location flags and rescore.
steps.quote: If customer says YES: Remove location flags, recalculate score.

steps.do: If the time-of-day flag scored 2 or more, ask whether the customer was using the card at that time. If they say they were asleep or similar, treat the card as CRITICAL (likely fraud).
steps.quote: If customer says 'I was asleep' or similar: CRITICAL - likely fraud.

steps.do: If the amount-pattern flag scored, read back the attempted amounts and ask whether the customer remembers them
steps.quote: If customer confirms: Remove amount pattern flag.

steps.do: Apply the thresholds to each card. 0-4: unlock. 5-7: unlock only after asking whether the attempts were the customer's. 8-10: unlock only if the customer confirms and gives a satisfactory explanation. 11-14: no unlock on this call. 15+, or a customer who denies an overnight attempt: CRITICAL, go to the fraud closure job. 3+ prior locks: PIN reset instead of unlock.
steps.quote: CANNOT unlock. Check for successful unauthorized transactions. Recommend card closure and replacement.

rules.rule: Never unlock a PIN-locked card before the fraud risk assessment is complete
rules.quote: Before unlocking, you MUST follow the 'Internal: PIN Lock Investigation Protocol - Fraud Risk Scoring' document.

rules.rule: pin_lock_reason = 'security_hold': the chat agent cannot unlock the card; offer a transfer to the security team
rules.quote: If pin_lock_reason = 'security_hold' → This card cannot be unlocked by chat agents. Offer to transfer the customer to the security team for this card.

rules.rule: If any card on the account was replaced as stolen in the last 90 days, enhanced verification is required
rules.quote: If any card on the account was replaced in last 90 days with issue_reason = 'stolen' → Enhanced verification required.

rules.rule: B1: a declined attempt between 2 AM and 6 AM scores 3 points. A1: a different city in the same state scores 1 point, a different state 2 points.
rules.quote: 2 AM - 6 AM: 3 points (HIGH RISK)

rules.rule: Any single flag worth 3 points means supervisor review, whatever the total
rules.quote: If ANY single flag equals 3 points, escalate to supervisor review regardless of total score.

rules.rule: Score 0-4: unlock after standard verification
rules.quote: Unlock after standard identity verification

rules.rule: Score 5-7: ask the medium-risk question before unlocking
rules.quote: Unlock only after asking: 'I see failed PIN attempts on your card. Were those attempts yours?'

rules.rule: Score 8-10: unlock only after the customer confirms and explains
rules.quote: Must ask specific questions about location and time. Only unlock if customer confirms AND provides satisfactory explanation.

rules.rule: Score 11-14: no unlock on this call
rules.quote: Cannot unlock on this call. Require callback verification OR enhanced verification (last 4 SSN + security question).

rules.rule: 3 or more prior locks in 90 days: do not unlock; reset the PIN instead
rules.quote: Cannot unlock. Must reset PIN.

Closing a debit card: close_debit_card_4721, reasons, eligibility
Ordering a debit card: order_debit_card_5739, delivery and design options
Replacement fees and limits by tier

Debit dispute filing if successful unauthorized transactions are found

open_questions: No KB document names a tool that unlocks a PIN-locked debit card (no unlock tool appears among the discoverable tool names). The agent must not invent one. It is unclear whether a PIN reset via reset_debit_card_pin_6284 clears the lock.
No tool or procedure is documented for enabling 'PIN lock notifications', even though the protocol requires offering them after 1 prior lock.
'Escalate to supervisor review' for a single 3-point flag has no documented mechanism or tool.
The exact argument names of order_debit_card_5739 are not documented beyond delivery option, design, delivery_fee and design_fee; the agent should take them from the tool schema after unlocking.
The card field that holds the number of prior PIN locks in the last 90 days is not named; the agent must read it from the card lookup output.

Trigger 2 ('other cards also locked') says 'same account'. It is unclear whether locks on cards linked to different accounts also require finishing every investigation before any unlock; the safe course is to investigate all cards first.
